name: Clips + posts for my socials
tagline: Clip a video and write a post for each clip
blurb: One App Hub call makes the clips; then your agent writes a post for each one for the platform you pick, from ClipForge's caption, hook and what is said. Needs App Hub open and its ClipForge connector added.

params.label: YouTube link or full path of a video file
How many clips to hand over

task: Use App Hub's ClipForge connector. Make exactly ONE call to its make_clips tool (mcp__clipforge__make_clips, or mcp__apphub__clipforge_make_clips if App Hub is connected as one connector) with input "{video}", wait_minutes 9, skip_if_done true, send_to_starnet "agent" and best {count}. Do not call any other App Hub or ClipForge tool and never start the same video twice. Then reply with: the video title and id, and each returned clip best first: hook title, length in seconds, score, its starnet.files path, and its ready-to-post caption. If a file's note says it is too big for Telegram, say so. If the status is not done, give the video id and say it is still working; if it is an error, quote the error exactly. Then, for each clip, write a {platform} post: a first line that stops the scroll, one or two short lines built from the clip's caption, hook and what is said (do not invent facts that are not in it), and 3-5 fitting hashtags. Put each post right under its clip.
